blind.description: A stylized four-tier wooden storage shelf reinforced with riveted dark iron corner posts and braces, filled with vault loot. The top tier holds two small arched treasure chests with metal banding. The second tier holds three round bronze or gold urns. The third tier contains a stacked pyramid of gold bars and a pile of rolled parchment scrolls with red wax seals. The bottom tier holds several small cloth loot sacks in green, gold, and red. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized with clean geometry, standing directly on four sturdy corner feet.
blind.from_above: A rectangular outline bounded by four square iron corner caps; within the shelf frame, the curved lids and metal straps of the two treasure chests are visible side by side.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly shoulder height on the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 4.8 ft tall), and is about half the figure's height in width (roughly 3 ft wide).
